home.subtitle: Спокойен престой за семейства и кратки почивки. Избирате дати онлайн, получавате личен отговор от рецепцията — без автоматично плащане.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.lead: Clear rules for online stay requests — what confirmation by the guesthouse means.
terms.intro: By submitting a booking request on this site, you confirm you have read these terms. The booking becomes binding only after explicit confirmation by the guesthouse (email or phone).
terms.s1Body: The online form creates a request, not a guaranteed booking. Rooms in your chosen option are held temporarily until we reply; if we cannot confirm, we release the dates. We contact you for the final price.
terms.s2Body: Minimum one night. Check-in and check-out times are those communicated when we confirm.
terms.s3Body: Cancellation or change terms are communicated with your booking confirmation.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How we process data submitted through the stay request form (GDPR).
privacy.intro: We comply with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR). This page describes how we process data you send via the stay request form.
privacy.collect2: Stay details (check-in, check-out, number of guests)
privacy.collect3: Optional message and minor information, if provided
privacy.useBody: To respond to your stay request, confirm availability, and manage your booking.
privacy.legalBody: Steps at your request before a contract and our legitimate interest (Art. 6 GDPR).
privacy.retentionBody: We keep data as long as needed to manage the booking and meet legal obligations (accounting, tax).
privacy.rightsBody: You have rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability. Contact <email>contact@hospira.ro</email>.

scoreHints.trust: Оценка 0–100 за поведение при престой. Започва от 60. След всеки приключен престой review от оператор я променя: звезди (1 = −28 … 5 = +16), положителни/отрицателни черти и корекция от review-а. Ръчно ±40 в таб Профил. Не е същото като blacklist/watchlist.
scoreHints.loyalty: Оценка 0–100 колко често гостът се връща. Без приключени престои остава 0. Расте с: +12 на престой (макс. 55), +1 на нощ (макс. 25), бонус за скорошен последен престой (до +20). Review-ите могат да добавят loyalty_delta. Ръчно ±40 в таб Профил.
scoreHints.stars: Средно от звездите в review-и след престои (1–5). Без review показваме 1,0 като начална стойност — не е реална оценка с една звезда.
